request.question: As the trade compliance reviewer, determine the correct export determination for order SO-MR-26-0931 under the SGR as in force on the requested ship date.

options.description: license_exception_lvs: A licence would otherwise be needed, but licence exception LVS validly covers this shipment.
license_required: An individual licence must be obtained before shipment; no exception is available.
no_license_required: The shipment may proceed without any licence and without using a licence exception.
shipment_prohibited: The shipment is prohibited outright (embargo) and cannot be licensed under the SGR.
